title: The first player's opening hand draws 3
notes: The owner's ask (#2368): Player 1, who goes first, opens on three cards again and Player 2 on four, OPENING_DRAW [3, 4], Hearthstone's split, superseding #1156's four for both (R2368000, superseding R1156000). A rule every game meets: every game's opening deal moves.

player.title: The first player opens on three cards
changes: The player who goes first now starts with three cards in their opening hand, down from four. The player who goes second still starts with four and The Coin.
